answer: The grove check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. A stake that vests on good behaviour turns each fake into a hostage: behave and it returns, spam and it is gone. The sonnet prices misbehaviour directly — the attacker must fund every clone up front and loses the stake on every clone the graders catch. The kernel does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
